summary.text: Jesse Rodriguez is the Republican candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Matt Hanson (D).
Rodriguez is a U.S. Navy veteran and small business owner from Aurora.

paragraphs.text: Rodriguez served in the U.S. Navy Reserve from 1984 to 1990 and earned a bachelor's degree from Loyola University Chicago in 1990 and a graduate degree from Loyola in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong Aurora resident who served as an aircrewman in a carrier-based anti-submarine warfare squadron.

Rodriguez said in the survey that he worked in personal insurance as a claims manager and fraud investigator and has owned a paint franchise serving Aurora and surrounding communities for the past 15 years.
He won the March 17, 2026 Republican primary.
